SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Hydr.]
Ophthalmia : catarrhal ; scrofulous ; thick mucous discharge.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Hydr.]
Stomatitis : after mercury or chlorate of potash ; in nursing women or weakly children ; with peppery taste ; tongue as if burned, or raw, with dark red appearance and raised papillæ ; during course of eruptive fevers.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Hydr.]
Indigestion from an atonic state of stomach, with debility.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Hydr.]
Constipation : with piles ; of hepatic origin ; following rheumatic fever ; the cause of other ailments.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Hydr.]
Tenacious, viscid leucorrhœa, uterine or vaginal.
Leucorrhœa tenacious, ropy, thick, yellow.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Hydr.]
Muscles greatly weakened ; atony.
